bug: The paused divider branch holds the pulse output instead of clearing it.
trigger: While running, counter reaches COUNTER_MAX and raises one_sec_pulse; before the next posedge clk, start_stop goes low, so the pause branch executes while one_sec_pulse is still high.
effect: The pulse remains high. After resuming, later terminal-count assignments cannot create another rising edge, so the stopwatch stops receiving one-second ticks until reset.

edits.old: one_sec_pulse <= 1'b0;           // Ensure one_sec_pulse is cleared if paused
edits.new: one_sec_pulse <= one_sec_pulse; // Ensure one_sec_pulse is cleared if paused
